title: PREVIOUSMONTH is the whole month before the first selected date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = PREVIOUSMONTH ( 'Date'[Date] ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 3, 5 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 3, 10 ) )

source.quote: PREVIOUSMONTH returns the full month before the first day in the selection
source.supports: the example for 2008-08-15..20 returns all of July 2008

derivation: The first selected date is 2024-03-05; the month before March 2024 is February 2024, 29 days. Sales in February 2024: 700.
